title: Improving Randomized Metric Distortion to 2.3282
abstract: arXiv:2608.29308v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In metric social choice, each voter ranks a set of $m$ candidates by her distance to them in an unknown metric space. The cost of a candidate is its average distance to the voters. A randomized voting rule must use only the rankings to choose a lottery over candidates. Its distortion is the worst-case ratio between the expected cost under the lottery it returns and the cost of the best candidate. Charikar, Ramakrishnan, Wang, and Wu [JACM 2024] prove an upper bound of $2.753$, establishing a constant separation from deterministic rules, for which the best achievable distortion is $3$. Independently, Frank [arXiv:2608.17863] and Ye [arXiv:2608.21202] improve the bound to $2.5$, using an equal mixture of maximal lottery and Integrated Veto. The existing arguments do not yield a better bound with any mixture of these rules.   We break this barrier with a new ingredient, a random-size stable lottery. translated_title: 将随机化度量失真改进至 2.3282
translated_abstract: 在度量社会选择中，每位选民根据她在一个未知度量空间中与各候选人的距离，对 m 个候选人进行排序。候选人的成本是其与选民的平均距离。随机化投票规则必须仅利用排序信息来选择候选人的一个抽签（彩票分布）。其失真定义为它所返回的抽签下的期望成本与最佳候选人成本之间的最坏情况比值。Charikar、Ramakrishnan、Wang 和 Wu [JACM 2024] 证明了 2.753 的上界，从而确立了与确定性规则之间的常数级分离——确定性规则可达到的最佳失真为 3。独立地，Frank [arXiv:2608.17863] 和 Ye [arXiv:2608.21202] 利用最大抽签与 Integrated Veto 的等比例混合，将该上界改进至 2.5。然而，现有论证无法通过这些规则的任何混合得到更好的界。我们引入一个新要素——随机规模稳定抽签——突破了这一障碍。设 D 是关于 d……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一种全新的“随机规模稳定抽签”技术，突破了现有规则混合方法的局限，将度量社会选择中随机投票规则的失真上界从 2.5 改进至 2.3282。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a novel "random-size stable lottery" technique that breaks the barrier of existing rule-mixture arguments, improving the distortion upper bound for randomized voting rules in metric social choice from 2.5 to 2.3282.
